# HOST_SERVICE

A container the lab runs on the host, as `setup-services` starts it.

<!-- Generated by nix/signature-docs.nix from nix build .#referencePages -->

Canonically `service`. A floe providing this must declare it
as `provides.service`; a hole that resolves it may be called
anything.

| volumes | attrs of any |
